questions.question: What time can I check in?
Yo, if I arrive late, do I gotta pay extra?
answer_facts: Arrivals between midnight and 6:00 am carry a ₹1,500 late-arrival fee.

questions.question: I'm arriving after 10 PM, what do I need to do?
answer_facts: Arrivals after 10:00 pm are fine but must be confirmed at least 24 hours ahead so the caretaker can meet you.

questions.question: How much is the fee for early check-in?
answer_facts: Early check-in (from 10:00 am) and late check-out (until 2:00 pm) are each ₹1,000 per villa.
